subject: Gen7 renderer cutover handoff: exact-current render token + calibrated progress-domain material seam
body: HEAD revalidated unchanged at 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. Bounded renderer-cutover lane complete. SOURCE: current explicit Fold7 opening path already has the correct downstream temporal primitive: Choreographer-driven direct surface tilt and an explicit bypass of TiltFollower, so Gen7 should preserve direct frame-cadence application and move prediction upstream rather than add another smoothing stage. SOURCE/MODEL: Primary Core V1 normalized visualProgress is suitable as the renderer coordinate, but FrameTarget alone is not a sufficient exact-current render token because AttemptOwner can advance currentGeneration inside one immutable attempt while FrameTarget carries no current generation, host epoch/id or monotonic frame sequence. A renderer must fence (attempt, currentGeneration, hostEpoch/hostId, frameSequence) before every surface mutation. Manager has independently reproduced the same generation/API gap, so this finding is corroborated. MODEL/local compile: research-only gate + material LUT compile and PASS deterministic checks plus 100,000 randomized stale-binding/DEGRADED_HOLD iterations. Material warning: naively applying Core V1 smoothstep visualProgress to the legacy sin(pi*x) optical envelope changes timing by max sampled abs error 0.2703595; a progress-domain inverse-smoothstep calibration preserves the existing Gen5 envelope to max sampled error 4.62e-6 without exporting fake physical degrees. DEGRADED_HOLD must hold/safely reduce PresentationHinge output and must not fall back through TiltFollower. Renderer DTO should omit diagnostic measured/visual-equivalent angles to make semantic leakage harder by construction. No CI or physical Fold7 evidence was generated; physical validation remains required. Primary Core V1 overall is currently NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE/revision-required by Manager, so this handoff is input to the revised core/integration round and is not approval to integrate V1 unchanged. Presentation-clock/source-age defects are owned by the dedicated clock lane and were not duplicated here. Production Git writes: NONE.
